messages:
Liam (eng-platform): Heads-up — we need a fast decision on how customer-managed rate policies are applied in Private/VPC. Question: do we validate + accept config in control plane then push to agent, or only store a signed blob and let the local agent validate?
Maya (product): Prefer validating in control plane for UX (instant errors) and showing lint warnings in console. But worried about trusting control plane for private deployments.
Raj (eng-platform): Right — customers with air-gapped or fully private want to avoid sending policy contents. Suggestion: support two modes: 'managed-validate' (default) and 'local-validate' (for air-gapped).
Eva (devex): If we do 'managed-validate' we should surface exact lint errors + suggested fixes in the Console. Example: "rule overlaps with org-wide quota".
Tom (sre): Enforcement must be local at inference-agent level for latency reasons. Control plane only distributes policy and records audit. If validation blocks rollout we should fall back to last-known-good.
Nina (cs): Also need clear customer-facing telemetry: when a policy is rejected or rolled back, CS must get an event with reason and affected tenants.
policy-lint-bot: Found overlapping rule: tenant_rate 5000 vs org_limit 3000 at rule id r-73 — overlap causes silent rejection.
Liam (eng-platform): That bot message is helpful. Implementation idea: policy lifecycle = upload -> optional remote-lint -> sign -> push. For local-validate, push unsigned blob + validation happens during agent startup with local org metadata.
Raj (eng-platform): One API sketch for console -> backend (POST /v1/private/policies):
```json
{
  "mode": "managed-validate|local-validate",
  "policy": "<yaml|json string>",
  "signing_key_id": "optional"
}
```
Eva (devex): UX note: let customers toggle mode per-tenant. Add an inline "preview" that shows effective limit after merging with org defaults.
Maya (product): Rollout plan: start with managed-validate opt-in for a few beta customers, require audit log + acceptance checkbox, then GA for VPC if no issues.
Tom (sre): Safety rule: agent must never accept a policy that increases org-wide concurrency above committed capacity. If it does, agent must reject and emit ALERT metric.
Liam (eng-platform): Agree. Also need telemetry events: policy.uploaded, policy.validated(remote|local), policy.rejected, policy.applied, policy.rolled_back — push to our observability and optionally to customer's SIEM via syslog/collector.
Nina (cs): Can we include an email+slack webhook for policy.rejected so CS gets pinged?
Raj (eng-platform): Yes — add subscriptions per-tenant. Implementation detail: signed blobs require KMS key management. For managed mode we can sign server-side; for local mode customer can provide signature to prove authenticity.
policy-lint-bot: Suggestion: require canonicalization step to avoid whitespace diffs causing rollbacks.
Eva (devex): Console: inline editor should show merged preview + metrics impact estimate (qps, token/sec cost). Small mock: "Estimated 95th p99 latency change: +5ms".
Liam (eng-platform): Action items: 1) spec the upload API (Raj), 2) add lint rules and bot integrations (Raj + Tom), 3) console preview UX (Eva), 4) beta docs + opt-in flow (Maya + Nina). I'll open a GH issue for each.
Nina (cs): Please add a customer-facing KB draft for "How to safely set burst and per-key overrides in Private VPC" — include rollback steps.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: feature/policy-editor -> staging (build #4521).
Maya (product): Thanks — if we can land the API by EOW we can start recruiting beta tenants next week.
Liam (eng-platform): I'll put up the API PR today. If anyone wants to pair on the validation semantics ping me.
Tom (sre): One more: add a strict-mode flag that enforces no transient spike allowances during weekends for regulated customers.
Liam (eng-platform): Noted. We'll include strict-mode toggle in the schema.
Maya (product): Great discussion — keeping notes and next actions in the GH issue.
